## CEO BRIEFING

The Batch API experienced an incident starting at 11:42 UTC today. The issue was confined to one of our two worker fleets (fleet-a), while the other (fleet-b) remained healthy.

We applied a mitigation at 12:58 UTC by moving all Batch API traffic to the healthy fleet. Since then, error rates have dropped significantly and are currently holding at approximately 0.3%. We are currently in a 90-minute verification window to ensure stability; this window closes at 14:30 UTC.

The root cause is not yet established. We are investigating two main hypotheses: a recent change to database connection pool settings in release `r3` and concentrated load on fleet-a. We have not yet performed a rollback test to confirm.

Impact: Seven customer accounts experienced failures. Contoso is the only affected customer with an SLA that carries service-level credits. We are currently re-driving failed jobs for all affected accounts, with roughly 60% completed so far.

If asked during your board call, you can state that the service is mitigated and recovering, and we are monitoring the situation closely before confirming full resolution.

## ENGINEERING UPDATE

**Status:** Mitigated. Verification window in progress (ends 14:30 UTC).

**Current State:**
- All Batch API traffic is routed to fleet-b.
- fleet-a is drained and out of rotation.
- Error rate on `POST /v1/batch/jobs` is holding at 0.3% (baseline 0.2%).
- Re-drive of failed jobs is ~60% complete with no new failures observed.

**Unresolved Items:**
- Root cause not established.
- `r3` rollback test has not been run.
- fleet-a has not been returned to service.

**Hypotheses:**
- **H1 (Leading):** Connection-pool change in `r3` (max pool size 80 -> 24). Workers on fleet-a were observed queueing on DB connections. Note: `r3` is also on fleet-b, which is healthy.
- **H2 (Secondary):** Concentrated load on fleet-a. Volume was ~3x morning average due to a wonka-industries scheduled job. Note: fleet-a handled higher peaks on 2026-11-03 without errors.
- **H3 (Rejected):** Upstream object-storage provider. Ruled out at 11:47; Files API is healthy.

## CUSTOMER EMAIL

Subject: Re: Batch submits failing

Dear Contoso team,

We are currently experiencing an incident affecting the Batch API, which began at 11:42 UTC. 

A mitigation has been applied and the service is recovering. We are currently monitoring the service closely before confirming full recovery.

Regarding your specific impact, our records show that between 11:42 and 12:58 UTC, you made 9,400 Batch API requests, of which 3,410 returned errors.

We will provide a further update at 15:30 UTC.

## STATUS PAGE UPDATE

We have applied a mitigation to the Batch API and the service is recovering. We are currently monitoring the service to ensure stability before confirming full recovery. We will provide a further update at 15:30 UTC.
